package.author: Pico Technology Ltd.
package.description: The next-generation user interface for all automotive USB PC Oscilloscopes, including all the analysis tools you need to get answers quickly, whether carrying out a simple test, or debugging a complex design.

en-US.author: Pico Technology Ltd.
en-US.description: The next-generation user interface for all automotive USB PC Oscilloscopes, including all the analysis tools you need to get answers quickly, whether carrying out a simple test, or debugging a complex design.
en-US.name: PicoScope Automotive
en-US.releaseNotes:
New features
- Serial decoding Action event: Actions can now be triggered when a serial decoder finds specified data or a decode error. Use it to stop the capture, save the file or play a sound the moment the event is decoded, so intermittent bus faults can be caught during unattended monitoring.
- Custom probe ranges: when creating or editing a custom probe, you can now set its ranges manually. This allows unipolar ranges, or ranges to match to a specific sensor output.
- ZACwire (OWI) serial decoder: new decoder for the ZACwire One-Wire Interface (OWI), the single-wire protocol used to calibrate, configure and read sensor signal conditioner ICs originally developed by ZMD (now Renesas), and the pressure, temperature and bridge sensors built on them.
- JTAG serial decoder: new decoder for JTAG (IEEE 1149.1), the test and debug interface used for boundary scan, device programming and on-chip debugging.
- Channel Deskew can now be set up to 20ms.
- Adding Notes will now automatically bring the caret into the Notes viewport.

Bug fixes
- Security fix for CVE-2026-111497
- Fixed: the CAN FD decoder could stop decoding during continuous capture after it encountered an error in the bus data.
- Fixed: the RPM ruler in Spectrum view showed an incorrect reading.
- Pinch zoom on touchscreens now locks to the intended axis more reliably.
- Time values of 1 minute or more now use a consistent days, hours, minutes and seconds format (for example, 1d 2h 30m 15s).
- Fixed: the UI could stop responding while the Math Channel options panel was open.
- General stability and minor UX improvements.
- [PicoDiagnostics] Fixed: issue when using UDS decoding.
- [PicoDiagnostics] Fixed: UI fault when selecting a VCI (vehicle communication interface) from the drop-down menu.
- [PicoDiagnostics] Fixed: display error in the NVH wizard.
- [PicoDiagnostics] Fixed: crash when closing the NVH wizard and relaunching the NVH plug-in.
- [PicoDiagnostics] Fixed: NVH settings were overwritten when no PicoScope oscilloscope was connected.
- [PicoDiagnostics] Improvements to UI when the screen scaling is greater than 100%.

zh-CN.description: 适用于所有车载 USB PC 示波器的新一代用户界面，集成了您所需的全部分析工具。无论是进行简单测试还是调试复杂设计，都能快速获得答案。
